title: Strange Maze Mall dream
content: OK I had a second dream of this kind so I'm unsure if it's a run of the mill type dream or is it going to become something. Anyway the first time I had thus dream I was working as a scientist at a university working at the intersection of biocomputing. We went on an assignment to check out a large abandoned maze/ obstacle course. Last night we had a biological companion to take to "maze" the objective was to see the success of the artificial companion as a guardian as well as an offensive unit. My co professor looked very similar to Kavan Smith from Stargate Atlantis. We got through the maze ok but the creature failed to operate as both an offensive and guardian. We brought two and they were supposed to be good enough.
